title: Hermeus footer
description: A near-white footer: bold wordmark, a three-line uppercase address in pale grey and a small flag slot at the left; two columns of small tracked uppercase links and a follow-us column of line icons at the right; a row of legal links split by bars and the copyright; and, last, the name set huge across the whole column in the next grey, cut off at the bottom edge. Links turn amber on hover.
notes: the giant name is an SVG stretched to the column width (textLength), so any word fills it
the flag slot is a small grey placeholder when empty
name: hermeus-footer

props.name: name
props.description: the wordmark at the top left, and the giant name at the bottom

props.name: address
props.description: the address, one entry per line (shown in capitals)

props.name: badge
props.description: a small flag or badge under the address (30×18); empty: a grey slot

props.name: badgeLabel
props.description: what the badge shows, for screen readers while it is empty

props.name: columns
props.description: link columns (two in the original), each a list of links

props.name: socialTitle
props.description: heading of the social column, e.g. "Follow us"

props.name: legal
props.description: legal links in the bottom row, split by thin bars
